mentions.name: Prison Legacy
mentions.description: A revival of La Prisión, the Spanish PC MMO from 1999 set in a maximum-security prison where every player is an inmate. The original game ran on community loyalty until its servers went dark in 2018, and this project is bringing the game back.
mentions.problem: The original La Prisión prison MMO went offline when its servers were shut down in 2018.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on this: https://www.prisonlegacy.com - Twenty-six years ago, a small Spanish studio shipped the most unusual PC MMO ever made: a maximum-security prison where every player is an inmate. La Prisión ran on community loyalty until its servers finally went dark in 2018. And we're bringing it back...
